name: Broken Image Checker (Find Internal or External Broken Images)
author: WPEasyTools

sections.description:
The Broken Image Checker plugin by WPEasyTools is one of the best SEO plugin that scans your WordPress site for broken images and provides a detailed report with the associated post or page URLs.

Features:

  • Scans posts and pages for broken images.
  • Displays a list of broken images along with their URLs and associated content.
  • Scan intenal images.
  • Scan external images inside your WordPress site.
  • Lightweight and easy to use.
  • Export report in csv format.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See the included LICENSE file for more details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the broken-image-checker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Broken Image Checker” in the admin menu to start scanning for broken images.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin fix broken images?

No, this plugin only detects broken images and reports them. You will need to fix the images manually.

Does the plugin scan custom post types?

Currently, the plugin only scans standard posts and pages.

How can I clean up the plugin data after uninstalling?

The plugin removes its cached data automatically when uninstalled.
